title: ELFLIQ Elfa Turbo Pod Vape Kit
description: The ElfLiq Elfa Turbo Kit is a compact refillable pod device built for convenience, portability, flavour, and everyday performance. Powered by a long-lasting 550mAh battery, it features two smart vaping modes: Turbo Mode (18W) delivers increased vapour and flavour, while Durable Mode (15W) offers a gentler output to help extend pod lifespan. Designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, the Elfa Turbo Kit is compatible with all ELFA Series Pods — including both refillable and prefilled options. The included 2ml refillable pods feature integrated mesh coils and a secure bottom-fill system, making them easy to top up and replace. Choose between 0.8ohm pods for a warmer, more open draw, or 1.1ohm pods for a tighter, classic inhale. The sleek metal body is lightweight yet durable, with a soft-touch finish and a clean, minimalist design. A three-stage LED indicator keeps you informed of battery life, and USB-C fast charging provides a full recharge in around 30 minutes — supporting up to 850 puffs per charge. Available in five vibrant colourways, the Elfa Turbo is the ideal choice for vapers who want a reliable, versatile pod system with excellent flavour and no unnecessary complexity.
